summary: Iteration 43 — Re-test of Sales Leads Kurator + Source Contact List feature after backend fixes from iteration 42. All 7 pytest tests now PASS (7/7 green). Both critical bugs from iteration 42 are confirmed FIXED: (1) POST /api/sales-leads now honors payload `curator` field (server.py:2054 uses `data.get('curator') or current_user.get('name','')`), (2) POST /api/contacts/{id}/convert-to-lead now correctly populates `source_contact_list_name` from `cl.get('title') or cl.get('name','')` (server.py:1981). Inconsistent contact-list schema persists at storage level (`title` field) — convert-to-lead now reads both via fallback (`title or name`), but a Pydantic model would prevent future regressions.
POST /api/sales-leads still accepts an arbitrary dict; consider a LeadCreate Pydantic schema for stricter validation.
